bullets.text: Apple Watch Detects Stroke Risk - Wearables like **Apple Watch** can flag atrial fibrillation, improving stroke risk detection.
Apple TV Crime Thriller Returns - **Apple TV** announces season 2 of acclaimed show *Criminal Record*, premiering April 22.
Apple's New Messages Feature - iOS 26 introduces 'Screen Unknown Senders' to filter spam texts effectively.
AirTag 2 Enhancements - The **AirTag 2** boasts improved range and sound, enhancing item tracking capabilities.
Microsoft Hits 1 Billion Users - **Windows 11** reaches 1 billion users faster than its predecessor, Windows 10.
Tesla Discontinues Model S and X - **Tesla** ends production of its flagship models to focus on AI and robotics.
Google's AI-Powered Chrome Feature - **Gemini AI** introduces 'auto browse' in Chrome, automating multi-step tasks.
Meta's AI Ambitions Grow - **Mark Zuckerberg** emphasizes AI's role in future social media during earnings call.
ServiceNow Partners with Anthropic - **ServiceNow** integrates **Anthropic**'s AI models into its enterprise workflow products.
AI Security Startup Funding - **Outtake** raises $40M to combat digital identity fraud with AI technology.
